verdict.rationale: Ollama runs a local REST API server (local base URLs, curl requests). Its docs state OpenAI clients can connect, though only a subset of the OpenAI API is supported. A community user confirms models can be hot-swapped on the running server without a restart, which covers 'any loaded model'. Missing for 10: documentation of which OpenAI endpoints the supported subset covers, and independent hands-on corroboration of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint itself.
